budget_items.what_was_recorded: The W&S contract stayed at the same amount after adding two extra days at no additional cost.

budget_items.topic: Capacity purchase cost (Fitchburg IMA and capacity fee policy)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total cost of the purchased capacity was given as a yearly figure and a per-gallon equivalent, described as a one-time cost for new users.
budget_items.quote: the total cost is $19,000/year for that capacity and equates to $1.87/gal of capacity

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Stated gallons: 45,000 gallons needed to stay ahead of the capacity curve; actual usage 30,000 gpa versus 70,000 allowed under the IMA.
budget_items.quote: we have to have 45,000 gallons to be available to stay ahead of capacity curve.

budget_items.topic: Septic system cost for Pratt St. residents
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A new septic system can cost a range of amounts, cited as an example for residents facing failing systems.
budget_items.quote: a new septic can cost anywhere from 20 - 45k, and there is a known water table issue in that neighborhood.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission will present its FY15 budget to the FinCom on Thursday; the budget is reported as balanced.
